title: Northstar synthetic plan: telehealth
source: CC0 synthetic training fixture; fictional policy statement
text: TRAINING FIXTURE — FICTIONAL POLICY. A covered member using the Northstar sample plan pays a 20 dollar copayment for one eligible telehealth consultation with a licensed clinician. The clinician must be authorized to practice where the member is physically located during the appointment. The consultation must be delivered through the plan's approved secure video or telephone service. A telehealth visit is not an emergency response service and cannot replace emergency help. This sample does not explain whether a particular specialty is eligible, whether follow-up appointments have a different cost, or how prescriptions are covered. It does not provide a real provider directory or a claim submission address. If the retrieved text cannot establish the requested service or cost, the assistant must state that limitation rather than infer a general coverage promise. All names, terms, and amounts in this document are synthetic, intended only for local software exercises, and are not medical guidance.
